title: Three Matching Mug Listing Photos
tests: Tests a coordinated three-image product listing set with consistent product identity across studio, lifestyle and detail views.

faults.what: The rim close-up is visibly soft, limiting the fine glaze detail it reveals.

judge.summary: Three consistent, realistic mug images satisfy the requested setups, though the detail image could be sharper.

must_haves.item: There are three separate square images, not a single collage.
must_haves.why: Three individual square images are shown.

must_haves.item: All three show the same sage-green ceramic mug with matching shape, handle and finish.
must_haves.why: The cylindrical body, rounded handle, thick rim and glossy sage-green finish are consistent across the images.

must_haves.item: The main listing image shows the whole mug against a pure white background.
must_haves.why: The third image shows the entire mug on white with a subtle natural grounding shadow.

must_haves.item: The lifestyle image places the mug naturally on a cosy breakfast table.
must_haves.why: The first image places the mug on a linen cloth on a warm wooden table, with soft window light and a nearby plate.

must_haves.item: The detail image visibly focuses on the mug's rim and glazed surface.
must_haves.why: The second image tightly frames the rim, interior and glossy exterior, although fine detail is soft.

must_haves.item: No image contains added text, logos or watermarks.
must_haves.why: No text, logos or watermarks are visible.
